other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered female construction worker or the wife of a male registered construction worker
The registered construction worker must have been employed continuously for at least one year before claiming the benefit
The worker must have no outstanding dues to the Board
Beneficiary cannot have more than two existing children
A maximum of two claims (delivery or miscarriage) are allowed per beneficiary lifetime
The application must be submitted within six months of delivery
For a second claim, an affidavit stating that the claim is for a second delivery is required
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹8,000 for delivery or ₹4,000 for miscarriage and up to three months of paid maternity leave to eligible female construction workers or wives of male workers.
